output_text:
Native SwiftUI iOS app for Hotlympics face ratings, leaderboards, photo uploads, and profiles.

Commands:
open ios-app.xcodeproj
xcodebuild -project ios-app.xcodeproj -scheme ios-app -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16 Pro' build
xcodebuild test -project ios-app.xcodeproj -scheme ios-app -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16 Pro'
xcodebuild clean -project ios-app.xcodeproj

Bundle ID: hotlympics.ios-app. Preferred Simulator: iPhone 16 Pro. Dependencies: Firebase Auth, Firebase Storage, Google Sign-In (via Swift Package Manager).
After making changes, build the project and fix any warnings or errors. Test on iPhone 16 Pro simulator.

Entry: `App/ios_appApp.swift` (Firebase setup, Google Sign-In URLs). Five tabs: Rating and Leaderboard are unrestricted; Upload, My Photos, and Profile require authentication and complete profile.

Core services: `auth/FirebaseAuthService` (Firebase/Google OAuth, session/token management, backend profile sync, gender/DOB and ToS updates); `data/ImageQueueService` (active and buffer blocks of 10, prefetch, gender filtering, auth-change reset); `api/RatingService`; `data/ImagePreloader` (shared NSCache, 50-image limit, memory-pressure clearing); `api/UploadService` (signed URL, Firebase Storage upload, progress, backend confirmation); `data/UserService` (5-minute cache, preloading, refresh after changes, optimistic deletion and pool cleanup).

Views: Rating (swipe cards and image pairs); Upload (camera/gallery, 400x400 crop, progress); Photos (grid, pool selection max 2); Auth (sign-in, sequential profile setup and ToS); shared `CachedAsyncImageView`. ViewModels manage photo/pool state and optimistic deletion, upload processing/progress/errors/retry.

Flows: Rating fetches image blocks, submits ratings, advances buffer and refills; auth changes reset queue. Upload selects/captures, crops and compresses, requests signed URL, uploads, confirms, refreshes cache, then navigates to My Photos. Google OAuth creates Firebase credential, syncs backend profile and token, checks profile completion; services are notified and queues/caches reset.

Base URL in `Constants.swift`: `https://hotlympics-server-670297845147.us-central1.run.app`
API: `GET /images/block?gender={gender}&count={count}`, `POST /ratings`, `GET /leaderboards/{gender}`, `POST /images/request-upload`, `POST /images/confirm-upload/{imageId}`, `GET /images/user`, `GET /user`, `PUT /user/profile`, `POST /user/accept-tos`, `PUT /user/pool`, `DELETE /images/{imageId}`. Requests include Firebase Auth Bearer token when available.

Users must complete their profile before accessing Upload, My Photos, and Profile tabs:
1. **Gender**: Must be set to "male" or "female" (not "unknown")
2. **Date of Birth**: Required for age verification (must be 18+)
3. **Terms of Service**: Must accept current version (1.0)
The app enforces these requirements:
Shows ProfileSetupView instead of tab content when profile is incomplete
Sequential flow: Gender/DOB first, then ToS acceptance
Server-side validation prevents uploads without complete profile
Rating and Leaderboard tabs remain accessible without profile completion

User model: identity, gender/DOB/ToS, uploaded and pool image IDs, rating count; computed profile-completion properties. Use singleton services, SwiftUI data binding/reactive updates, async/await, task-based concurrent fetching, protocol-oriented abstractions, optimistic updates with rollback, and multi-tier caching.
